text:
Aisha (PM): Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we flagged a recurring latency spike pattern across the last 3 incidents. Need to break down action items, owners, and a short recurrence mitigation plan.
Ravi (Eng): I can take the hotpath fix (redis sharding + connection pooling). Plan: prototype sharding config + perf run in staging. ETA: 2 weeks.
Tom (SRE): I'll own the alert noise reduction and add deduping rules. Also propose lowering the 95th->90th alert window to avoid missing early signals. ETA: 5 business days for alerts + dashboards.
Claire (Oncall): I'll update the oncall playbook with escalation steps and a post-incident checklist for recurrence verification. Will add who to escalate to for capacity ops. ETA: 3 days.
Aisha (PM): Thanks. Let's split into sub-tasks so we can track separately and validate. I'll create INF-2069-01 (hotpath fix), INF-2069-02 (alerting & dashboards), INF-2069-03 (playbook + handoff), INF-2069-04 (staging soak + perf validation).
jira-bot: Created INF-2069-01, INF-2069-02, INF-2069-03, INF-2069-04: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2069-01
Ravi (Eng): Adding acceptance criteria to INF-2069-01: 1) median p95 token-latency < baseline+10% under 75th pct load, 2) no >1 sustained error spike after rollout, 3) rollback plan documented. Also uploading a small config diff:
```
# redis-shard config snippet
shards:
  - id: shard-a
    host: redis-a.internal:6379
  - id: shard-b
    host: redis-b.internal:6379
```
Tom (SRE): For INF-2069-02 I'll add the alert rule and a dedupe window. Proposed rule (will refine in PR):
```
- alert: HighTokenLatency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[1m])) by (le, service)) > 300
  for: 2m
```
Will also attach a small doc on how to validate in staging.
Claire (Oncall): On INF-2069-03 I'll include the handoff checklist and a short "how to validate recurrence is fixed" section: 1) watch staging soak for 48h, 2) compare alerts frequency to baseline, 3) run synthetic load test.
Aisha (PM): RACI proposal for the bundle: R=Ravi (hotpath), A=Aisha, C=Tom+Claire, I=platform-sre and core-eng. OK?
Ravi (Eng): Sounds good to me.
Tom (SRE): +1.
Claire (Oncall): OK by me.
Aisha (PM): I'll set a milestone and due dates: INF-2069-01 due 2060170000 (2 weeks), INF-2069-02 due 206000; we'll keep INF-2069-02 due 2060040000 (5 days), INF-2069-03 due 2060016800 (3 days), INF-2069-04 due 2060140000 (10 days). Will ping in the incident-review channel with links to tickets and a calendar invite for the recurrence checkpoint 2 weeks from today.
Ravi (Eng): Note: INF-2069-01 touches connection config and may require short maintenance window. Please flag any blackout periods.
Tom (SRE): I'll coordinate maintenance with infra calendar and add ops contact in the ticket.
Aisha (PM): One ask: please add 2-3 bullet "How to validate" checks in each ticket so the incident reviewer can sign off.
Ravi (Eng): Will add to INF-2069-01 and link a staging perf run URL: https://perf.redwood.internal/runs/4382
Tom (SRE): I'll add dashboard snapshots and a short runbook test script to INF-2069-02.
Claire (Oncall): Adding playbook PR link once created and will tag the next oncall rotation for review.
Aisha (PM): Thanks all. If anything regresses flag immediately and we'll reconvene. Saving this thread as the single source of truth for owners. :spiral_note_pad:
